name: Tuxerhof
beschreibung: The Alpin Spa Hotel Tuxerhof is a family-run 5-star wellness hotel in Vorderlanersbach, a district of the municipality of Tux in the Zillertal valley. The hotel sits at around 1,300 metres above sea level, right next to the valley station of the Rastkogelbahn – the gateway to the Zillertal 3000 ski area – and around 9 kilometres from the Hintertux Glacier. Since 1930 the business has been run by the Schneeberger family, now in its fourth generation. Guests can expect comfortable rooms and suites, a restaurant serving regional and international cuisine, and a spacious wellness area with an infinity pool on the roof and several saunas. In summer and winter, a dedicated activity programme with guided hikes and bike tours provides entertainment. The Tuxerhof combines tradition with contemporary comfort.
